The '''1959–60 Turkish National League''' was the second season of professional [[football in Turkey]]. The league consisted of 20 clubs, with [[Beşiktaş J.K.]] winning their third championship.<ref name=5960millilig>Sivritepe, Erdinç [https://www.angelfire.com/nj/sivritepe/5960/tl.html 1959-1960 Milli Lig] turkish-soccer.com, accessed 21 June 2010</ref>

==Overview==
The original sixteen clubs of the [[1959 Milli Lig]] took part in the 1959–60 edition, along with newly promoted [[Kasımpaşa S.K.|Kasımpaşa]], [[Etimesgut Şekerspor|Şeker Hilal]], [[Altınordu S.K.|Altınordu]], and [[Feriköy G.K.|Feriköy]]. [[Beşiktaş J.K.|Beşiktaş]] won their first league title, winning 11 matches by a 1–0 margin, a record at the time. [[Metin Oktay]] finished top scorer with 33 goals. Clubs were not relegated directly, but instead took part in the Baraj Maçları, a competition between the top four amateur clubs and the bottom three Milli Lig clubs.<ref name=5960millilig />

Altınordu finished first in the Baraj Maçları, allowing them to stay in the Milli Lig. Hacettepe and Adalet were not successful, earning relegation to the Ankara and Istanbul professional leagues respectively. [[Adana Demirspor]] and [[Türk Telekom Gençlik Spor Kulübü|PTT]] earned promotion to the Milli Lig. Adana Demirspor would become the first club from outside of the big three cities ([[Ankara]], [[Istanbul]], and [[İzmir]]) to compete in the Milli Lig during the following season.<ref name=5960millilig />
